specialty: A target tower that cannot hit one of these properties needs a specialty before that round. Prefer a hero, because hero cash takes no tower-XP share. If the hero cannot cover it, place the cheapest tower whose attack does, and stop upgrading it once the hole is closed. Sell it on the next round after the target's own upgrade covers the same property, so rounds 51-80 are not split. If the hole lasts through round 80, leave the specialty up: its cash share is the cost of finishing, and a death on round 63 pays much less than a finished Hard game.
